notes.title: It's Been a Year since launch! Yay! Lets talk how it all went wrong...
notes.notes:
Alright, strap yourselves in

This game Released on December 23, 2022. I had big hopes for this one. About 2-3 months after release I began work on a major overhaul for the gaming Including but not limited to:
-Major Tutorial Overhaul
-Tank
-Different space ships
-All sorts of fun gadgets
-Quest line

About 3 or 4 weeks from the Major update's release... The Drive I had the game on began to fail (I didn't notice yet) after a week or two... I began to notice... Horrible slowdowns. Corruption... All the bad things. So I began to back up whatever I could... Too late. The next day... The drive failed. With it went Half of Hunted (Previous Game), All of Roaming The Stars, and all the things made to support both games.

So I didn't "leave the game" on purpose. I never "took the money" and ran... I didn't want to leave you all out stranded. I did my best To try to Recover whatever I could. But the years of Progress I lost could not be remade. I reinstated backups but certain things didn't play nice with other things and I could never get anything to work. 

Why did I wait until now to say anything? 

Because I thought I'd be able to get something back and push something out. I can't. It's been almost a year, I've done my best, It's gone. 

I know the game is dead. All of you have left. I know none of you will see this. But if you do. I'm so sorry.

All the best,
DrierWhisper729

notes.title: Major Update V1.10 "Other Worlds"
notes.notes:
This update brings a host of changes, fixes, and additions.

Added:
-Sentry Cannons now drop 3x Exotic Ferrite when destroyed
-New Planetary System "Craterous Outer" 
-Space Rock Warning Siren (Warns you of incoming Meteors and Asteroids)

New Planetary System:
-4 New Planets/Moons
-Green/Forested Moon
-Snow SubMoon
-Desert Moon
-Asteroid (Yes you can land on it)
-Red Deserted Planet (Similar To Mars)


Achievement:
-Added The "It's So Bright..." Achievement, Detonate A Nuclear Weapon
